messages:
Maya R: Opening a small docs PR now — adding a compact runbook for handling combined 429 + downstream timeouts. Need short Node and Go SDK snippets, and one-line guidance for context trimming. ETA: EOD today. PTAL?

Aj Patel: can do Node snippet. will keep it to 6 lines. do you want backoff example or immediate retry-with-jitter?

Maya R: backoff with jitter + max attempts. show both 429 and 504 branches.

DocOps Bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :robot_face: 

Liam Chen: I'll add the Go snippet and a one-liner about trimming prompt prefixes + link to ctx-trim guide. quick Q: should we recommend batch retries or per-request for dedicated?

Sophia Gomez: recommend per-request + server-side batching note. also flag that Dedicated supports request-level quota. I'll review links.

Aj Patel: Node snippet ready: ```js
const backoff = (n)=>Math.min(1000*(2**n), 8000) + Math.random()*200;
for (let i=0;i<5;i++){ try{ await client.generate(...); break } catch(e){ if (e.status===429) await sleep(backoff(i)) else throw } }
```

Liam Chen: Go snippet draft: ```go
b := func(attempt int) time.Duration{ return time.Duration(math.Min(8000,1000*math.Pow(2,float64(attempt)))) * time.Millisecond }
for i:=0;i<5;i++{ resp, err := c.Generate(ctx, req); if err==nil { break } if apiErr, ok := err.(*api.Error); ok && apiErr.Code==429 { time.Sleep(b(i)) } else { return err } }
```

Maya R: Nice — keep code inline (no long imports). Add a comment about honoring Retry-After header when present.

Sophia Gomez: I fixed links in the PR diff — replaced old ctx-trim link with /docs/context-trimming and added warning about token accounting.

Aj Patel: added a tiny test snippet for the Node example that asserts we stop after 5 tries.

Liam Chen: added note: use cached prefixes when possible; linking to cache page.

DocOps Bot: Deployment preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/4123 :eyes: 

Maya R: Thanks all. @Sophia @Liam please approve when green. I'll merge after CI passes and follow up with a tiny changelog entry.
